subject: Four bottles in: a creator who already uses your niacinamide
body:
Hi The Ordinary team,

I'm Maya. Your niacinamide is a fixture in my 5am routine, and I recently finished my fourth bottle and told my followers it's a forever repurchase.

My content is honest, routine-led skincare, so featuring a product I already use every day would feel natural rather than scripted.

Would you be open to sending a product for an honest routine video? I'd love to show your niacinamide alongside the rest of my morning.

Thanks for reading,
Maya (@maya)
